```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
```



```{r message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```


# Load SCE object
```{r}
sce <- HDF5Array::loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("../../datasets/GSE144136.h5se")
```


# Consider a subset of cell to speed-up the demo
```{r}
sce <- sce[,1:10000]
counts(sce) <- as.matrix(counts(sce))
```



# Run QC pipeline
```{r}
source("lib_QC.R")
x <- transcriptomic_pipeline(sce,output_dir = "qc_GSE144136",min_nfeatures = 1000)
```


# Use an AI to predict cell types
```{r}
library(scml)
fm <- luz::luz_load("../data/aba_mouse_subclass_classifier.luz")

p <- predict_delayed(log1p(t(counts(x)) / x$sum * 10e3)/log(2),fm,ignore.case = TRUE)
x$p_lab <- colnames(p)[max.col(p)]
x$p_lev1 <- sub(" --- .*","",x$p_lab)
x$p_lev2 <- sub("(.*) --- .*","\\1",x$p_lab)

plotUMAP(x,color_by="p_lev2")
```


# Show prediction accuracy
```{r,fig.height=8}
library(tidyverse)
table(ai=x$p_lab,paper=x$cell_type) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  group_by(paper) |>
  mutate(pct = Freq/sum(Freq)) |>
  ggplot() + 
    geom_tile(aes(y=paper,x=ai,fill=pct)) + 
    geom_text(aes(y=paper,x=ai,label=Freq)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90,hjust=1,vjust=0.5))
```




# Train a new Articficial Intelligence on the data to reconize a given pattern
```{r,message=FALSE}
fm <- scml::train_delayed_classifier(
  log1p(t(counts(x)) / x$sum * 10e3)/log(2),
  x$disease_state,pre_pruning_epoch = 2,post_pruning_epoch = 2,
  accelerator = luz::accelerator(cpu=TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
plot(fm)
```

# performance on training set
```{r}
p <- predict_delayed(log1p(t(counts(x)) / x$sum * 10e3)/log(2),fm)
table(x$disease_state,colnames(p)[max.col(p)])
x$suicide_score <- p[,"Suicide"] - p[,"Control"]
```


```{r}
ggcells(x) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(y=p_lev1,x=suicide_score,fill=patient_id))
```
